package curriculum

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"testing"
)

type diagnosticFixture struct {
	state     domain.DiagnosticPlanningState
	overview  domain.StudentLearnerOverview
	ensureErr error
	plans     int
	reads     int
	input     PlanInput
}

func (f *diagnosticFixture) EnsureDiagnosticPlacement(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticPlacementSummary{Band: "CORE", RouteCode: "START_CORE"}, f.ensureErr
}
func (f *diagnosticFixture) GetDiagnosticPlanningState(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticPlanningState, error) {
	return f.state, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticFixture) GetLearnerOverview(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentLearnerOverview, error) {
	f.reads++
	return f.overview, nil
}
func (f *diagnosticFixture) CreateCoursePlan(_ context.Context, input PlanInput) (PlanResult, error) {
	f.plans++
	f.input = input
	f.state.Request = &domain.DiagnosticPlanningRequest{RequestID: plannerRequestID, Status: "PLANNING"}
	return PlanResult{}, nil
}
func diagnosticService() (Diagnostic, *diagnosticFixture) {
	f := &diagnosticFixture{state: domain.DiagnosticPlanningState{PlanID: plannerRequestID, GoalCode: "go.backend", DirectionCode: "backend", OnboardingVersion: 2}, overview: domain.StudentLearnerOverview{StudentID: plannerStudentID, Onboarding: &domain.StudentOnboardingSnapshot{GoalCode: "go.backend", DirectionCode: "backend", Version: 2}}}
	return Diagnostic{Gateway: f, Overview: f, Plans: f}, f
}
func TestDiagnosticCompletionNeverPlansIncludingFailedRequest(t *testing.T) {
	for _, status := range []string{"", "PLANNING", "FAILED"} {
		t.Run(status, func(t *testing.T) {
			d, f := diagnosticService()
			if status != "" {
				f.state.Request = &domain.DiagnosticPlanningRequest{RequestID: plannerRequestID, Status: status, FailureCode: "ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED"}
			}
			_, err := d.Complete(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Zero(t, f.plans)
		})
	}
}
func TestDiagnosticExplicitPlanUsesFrozenContextAndStableIntent(t *testing.T) {
	d, f := diagnosticService()
	result, err := d.Plan(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "PLANNING_PENDING", result.Status)
	require.Equal(t, plannerRequestID, f.input.DiagnosticPlanID)
	require.Equal(t, plannerRequestID, f.input.IdempotencyKey)
	require.Equal(t, "go.backend", f.input.GoalCode)
	require.Equal(t, PlanConstraints{}, f.input.Constraints)
}
func TestDiagnosticStaleContextDoesNotPlan(t *testing.T) {
	d, f := diagnosticService()
	f.overview.Onboarding.Version++
	result, err := d.Plan(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "DIAGNOSTIC_CONTEXT_STALE", result.Status)
	require.Zero(t, f.plans)
}
func TestDiagnosticReloadUsesAcceptedJobBeforeProfileChanges(t *testing.T) {
	d, f := diagnosticService()
	f.state.Request = &domain.DiagnosticPlanningRequest{RequestID: plannerRequestID, Status: "PLANNING"}
	f.overview.Onboarding = nil
	result, err := d.Complete(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "PLANNING_PENDING", result.Status)
	require.Zero(t, f.reads)
	require.Zero(t, f.plans)
}
func TestDiagnosticCompletedPathRequiresStudentOwnerIdentity(t *testing.T) {
	d, f := diagnosticService()
	f.state.Request = &domain.DiagnosticPlanningRequest{RequestID: plannerRequestID, Status: "COMPLETED", LearningPathID: plannerRequestID}
	_, err := d.Complete(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.Error(t, err)
	f.overview.LearningPath = &domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: plannerRequestID, StudentID: plannerStudentID}
	_, err = d.Complete(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.Error(t, err)
	f.overview.LearningPath.Status = "PAUSED"
	f.overview.LearningPath.IsSelected = true
	_, err = d.Complete(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.Error(t, err)
	f.overview.LearningPath.Status = "ACTIVE"
	f.overview.LearningPath.IsSelected = false
	result, err := d.Complete(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "LEARNING_PATH_ACTIVE", result.Status)
}
func TestDiagnosticDependencyFailureAndInvalidActorNeverPlan(t *testing.T) {
	d, f := diagnosticService()
	f.ensureErr = domain.ErrCurriculumUnavailable
	_, err := d.Plan(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.Zero(t, f.plans)
	_, err = d.Complete(context.Background(), "bad", plannerRequestID)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidCurriculum)
}
func TestDiagnosticOnlyExhaustedJobMayRetry(t *testing.T) {
	for _, code := range []string{"DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID", "ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED"} {
		t.Run(code, func(t *testing.T) {
			d, f := diagnosticService()
			f.state.Request = &domain.DiagnosticPlanningRequest{RequestID: plannerRequestID, Status: "FAILED", FailureCode: code}
			_, err := d.Plan(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			if code == "ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED" {
				require.Equal(t, 1, f.plans)
			} else {
				require.Zero(t, f.plans)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticFailureRetryabilityIsOwnerPolicy(t *testing.T) {
	for _, code := range []string{"ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED", "DIAGNOSTIC_PLAN_INVALID", "INVALID_INTENT"} {
		t.Run(code, func(t *testing.T) {
			d, f := diagnosticService()
			f.state.Request = &domain.DiagnosticPlanningRequest{RequestID: plannerRequestID, Status: "FAILED", FailureCode: code}
			result, err := d.Complete(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, code == "ATTEMPTS_EXHAUSTED", result.PlanningRetryable)
			require.Zero(t, f.plans)
		})
	}
}

func TestDiagnosticNoGapAndPermanentFailureRemainTerminalWithoutPlanning(t *testing.T) {
	d, f := diagnosticService()
	f.state.Request = &domain.DiagnosticPlanningRequest{RequestID: plannerRequestID, Status: "COMPLETED", ResultCode: "NO_GAP"}
	result, err := d.Plan(context.Background(), plannerStudentID, plannerRequestID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "NO_GAP", result.Status)
	require.Zero(t, f.plans)
}
